market_context.headline: Massachusetts Cannabis Market Under Margin Pressure
key_points: Wholesale flower prices have dropped ~50% since 2021 ($300/oz → $150/oz)
1,693 licensed entities competing in a mature market

pressure_signals.name: Manufacturing Without Cultivation
pressure_signals.description: Dependent on external supply chain for raw material

likely_leaks.name: Burn Without Revenue
likely_leaks.description: Paying rent, utilities, and holding costs without generating income
likely_leaks.quick_win: Fast-track to operations or consider sublease options

likely_leaks.name: Supply Chain Vulnerability
likely_leaks.description: Dependent on external suppliers with variable pricing and availability

likely_leaks.name: Inventory Waste & Shrinkage
likely_leaks.description: Product loss from spoilage, damage, or compliance issues
likely_leaks.quick_win: Tighten inventory controls and FIFO rotation

fast_wins.name: SKU Rationalization
fast_wins.description: Eliminate slow-moving products draining production time

fast_wins.name: Batch Size Optimization
fast_wins.description: Right-size batches to minimize waste and storage

first_change: Focus all resources on getting to revenue. Every month of delay is pure cost. Identify the single biggest blocker and dedicate 80% of your time to removing it.
